"""Run a target under a CPU-rate-limited job (stretches ms-scale execution to seconds),
dump memory repeatedly during execution.

Usage: python midcap.py <dir> <tag> <stdin_text> [cpu_percent] [max_snapshots]
Writes <dir>/<tag>.snapN + .idx.json
"""
import sys, os, ctypes, ctypes.wintypes as wt, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"<G5A_WORKDIR>").resolve()

def safe(p) -> Path:
    rp = Path(p).resolve()
    if rp != ROOT and ROOT not in rp.parents:
        raise ValueError("outside ROOT")
    return rp

k32 = ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)

class JOBOBJECT_CPU_RATE_CONTROL(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('ControlFlags', wt.DWORD), ('CpuRate', wt.WORD), ('Pad', wt.WORD)]

JobObjectCpuRateControlInformation = 21
JOB_OBJECT_CPU_RATE_CONTROL_ENABLE = 0x1
JOB_OBJECT_CPU_RATE_CONTROL_HARD_LIMIT = 0x4
PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS = 0x1F0FFF

def main():
    wdir = safe(sys.argv[1])
    tag = sys.argv[2]
    stdin_bytes = sys.argv[3].encode().decode('unicode_escape').encode('latin1') if len(sys.argv) > 3 else b'hello\n'
    cpu_pct = int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 2
    max_snaps = int(sys.argv[5]) if len(sys.argv) > 5 else 8
    job = k32.CreateJobObjectW(None, None)
    ctrl = JOBOBJECT_CPU_RATE_CONTROL()
    ctrl.ControlFlags = JOB_OBJECT_CPU_RATE_CONTROL_ENABLE | JOB_OBJECT_CPU_RATE_CONTROL_HARD_LIMIT
    ctrl.CpuRate = cpu_pct * 100
    r = k32.SetInformationJobObject(job, JobObjectCpuRateControlInformation,
                                    ctypes.byref(ctrl), ctypes.sizeof(ctrl))
    print('SetInformationJobObject', bool(r), ctypes.get_last_error())
    p = subprocess.Popen([str(wdir / 'app.exe')], cwd=str(wdir),
                         stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    hproc = k32.OpenProcess(PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, False, p.pid)
    r2 = k32.AssignProcessToJobObject(job, hproc)
    print('AssignProcessToJobObject', bool(r2), ctypes.get_last_error())
    p.stdin.write(stdin_bytes); p.stdin.close()
    t0 = time.time()
    snap = 0
    while snap < max_snaps and p.poll() is None:
        time.sleep(0.4)
        if p.poll() is not None:
            break
        out = wdir / f'{tag}.snap{snap}'
        r = subprocess.run(['<PY312>', str(ROOT / '_work' / 'memdump_nokill.py'), str(p.pid), str(out)],
                           capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(f'[{time.time()-t0:5.1f}s] snap{snap}: {r.stdout.strip()} {r.stderr.strip()}')
        snap += 1
    try:
        out, err = p.communicate(timeout=30)
        print(f'exit rc={p.returncode} out={out!r}')
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        p.kill()
        print('killed (timeout)')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
